title: Total distance calculation
description: Essential Criteria: Student must correctly calculate the total displacement from A to B as 16 m using the v-t graph areas.

title: Friction force magnitude
description: Essential Criteria: Student must determine the friction force magnitude during 1-2 s as 4 N using Newton's second law.

title: Friction force direction
description: Important Criteria: Student must correctly identify the friction force direction as upward along the conveyor belt during 1-2 s.

title: Acceleration from v-t graph
description: Important Criteria: Student must correctly extract the acceleration during 1-2 s from the v-t graph slope.

title: Kinetic friction coefficient
description: Essential Criteria: Student must calculate the coefficient of kinetic friction as 0.5 using the friction force and normal force.

title: Newton's second law application
description: Important Criteria: Student must correctly apply Newton's second law to the inclined plane with both gravity and friction components.

title: Area under v-t graph
description: Important Criteria: Student must correctly calculate displacements by finding areas under the v-t graph for both time intervals.

title: Sign error in forces
description: Pitfall Criteria: Student incorrectly assigns signs to friction or gravity components in the force equation.

title: Normal force confusion
description: Pitfall Criteria: Student uses mg instead of mgcos37° for the normal force in the friction formula.
